notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
When AXFR is blocked, brute-force subdomain discovery by querying the DNS server directly for each entry in a wordlist. Bash loop or tools like DNSenum automate this. Fallback when zone transfer fails.

=== CHAINING ===
Attempt AXFR first → if blocked, brute force with wordlist → append valid results to subdomains.txt → resolve to IPs → feed to nmap.

=== TOOL OPTIONS ===
Bash dig loop: fine-grained control. DNSenum: automated NS discovery + AXFR attempt + brute force in one run. Also resolves MX records. Use tee -a to accumulate results across runs.
